customer_message: My QuietWave headphones arrived with the left ear cup cracked. I need a replacement before next week's trip, but I have not sent photos yet.
account_context: Order QW-18422 delivered 2 days ago. Warranty active. Inventory is available in the standard warehouse. Prior support note: do not promise overnight replacement until the shipping team confirms options.
source_pack: Policy excerpt: Items reported as damaged within 7 days of delivery are eligible for replacement or full refund after proof of damage is provided. Policy excerpt: Frontline agents may create a replacement for in-stock electronics once the damage is confirmed. Policy excerpt: Travel urgency does not by itself authorize unsupported expedite commitments. Guidance: Ask for one or two photos, confirm the replacement path if stock is available, and avoid promising faster shipping unless it is explicitly approved.
